description: Defines structures and functions for calculating the number of PRBs (Physical Resource Blocks) needed for PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) transmissions in 5G NR, based on payload size and configuration parameters.

classes.name: prbs_calculator_sch_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for calculating the number of PRBs needed for a PDSCH transmission.

classes.name: sch_prbs_tbs
classes.description: Output structure containing the number of PRBs and the TBS (Transport Block Size) in bytes.

methods.name: get_nof_prbs
methods.description: Calculates the number of PRBs and TBS for a given payload size based on the configuration.

methods.name: estimate_required_nof_prbs
methods.description: Provides a coarse estimate of the number of PRBs needed for a payload size.
